articles.summary: Darden Restaurants, Inc. (NYSE: DRI) plans to release its fiscal 2027 second quarter financial results before the market opens on Friday, December 18, 2026. The Company will host a conference call, led by Rick Cardenas, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Raj Vennam, Chief Financial Officer, to review second quarter results and conduct a question‑and‑answer session on Friday, December 18, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET. The conference call will be webcast and can be accessed through the Company's Investor Relations website at investor.darden.com . Supplementary materials will be available on the website prior to the start of the conference call. A replay of the webcast will be available on the Company's Investor Relations website shortly after the conclusion of the call. About Darden Darden is a full-service restaurant company featuring a portfolio of differentiated brands that include Olive Garden, LongHorn Steakhouse, Yard House, Ruth's Chris Steak House, Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen,
articles.title: Darden Restaurants to Release Fiscal 2027 Second Quarter Results on December 18, 2026
